name: robots/clvrai__furniture-bench
title: FurnitureBench FurnitureSim-v0 (Isaac Gym)
intro: FurnitureBench FurnitureSim-v0 (Isaac Gym), adapted from clvrai/furniture-bench. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
